description: Delete a screen, component, pattern, mockup (variant: one mockup variant, mockup only) or use-case kind (persona, dimension, entity, relationship_type, constellation, data_object, use_case) by id. Screens with variant screens are refused unless cascade: true (screen only). Screens warn mapping_stale for use-case steps.
